picked.t: 2 South Koreans jailed for beating compatriot restaurant owner to death in Ho Chi Minh City
picked.body: The Ho Chi Minh City People's Court on Sept. 4 sentenced Kim Jin, 31, to life in prison and Kang Yo Han, 30, to 20 years for murder. The victim, a South Korean restaurant owner, died after Kim struck him in the head with a metal canister containing nitrous oxide. A South Korean manager at the restaurant was also attacked and survived with injuries that resulted in an 87% disability, the court heard. The incident occurred early on Dec. 28, 2024, after Lee Chang Dae, a friend of Kim, and three other South Koreans went to the restaurant on Tran Hung Dao Street to drink and sing karaoke. At around 2:30 a.m., Lee damaged an LED screen in the karaoke room. A dispute broke out when an employee asked him to pay for the damage. The restaurant owner and manager went to the room to resolve the dispute, but a fight followed. The manager called police, while one of Lee's friends contacted Kim and told him the group "had gotten into trouble." Kim then asked Kang to accompany him to the restaurant. The two had been drinking at a nearby pub on Bui Vien Street. By the time they arrived, local police and security personnel were already at the restaurant. Kim allegedly grabbed a rubber baton from a patrol member before entering the room with Kang. The two then locked the door and attacked the owner and manager. Kim struck the owner in the head with the nitrous oxide canister, causing him to collapse. He had died by the time police broke into the room. At trial, Kim admitted attacking the victims but said he could not clearly remember what happened. He said he did not know why his friends were in trouble when he received the message. "I was not in a sober state at the time of the incident," he told the court. The jury board said the defendants had committed the crime in a violent manner and caused "particularly serious consequences." It also said they had attacked two people despite not knowing the reason for the original dispute. Kim received the heavier sentence because he was the one who asked Kang to go to the restaurant. The court also ordered the defendants to jointly pay more than VND5 billion (US$190,000) to the deceased's family and more than VND3 billion to the injured manager, after deducting more than VND1.3 billion already paid in compensation. Both men apologized to the victims and their families in their final statements.

picked.t: CEO of Vietnam International Financial Center in HCMC could get $32,000 monthly salary
picked.body: The proposal is included in a submission by the city People's Committee to the People's Council, the legislature, on salaries, benefits, and bonuses for personnel working in the management of the financial center (VIFC-HCMC). Other top executives and specialists and advisers could be paid salaries ranging from tens to hundreds of millions of dong a month. Salaries for other employees too could reach hundreds of millions of dong. The VIFC-HCMC was launched in February 2026 with the goal of developing a financial services ecosystem, attracting international capital and connecting Vietnam's financial market with global markets. A 2026 Vietnamese salary survey by Navigos Group found that CEOs and general directors of financial services, insurance, and securities companies earned VND184-419 million a month. At the VIFC-HCMC, the proposed VND100-180 million salary for the CEO is also higher than the VND86-141 million range for marketing and communications directors and department heads, the survey found. But the proposed VND30-60 million salary for specialists is broadly in line with the VND18-61 million range for experienced specialists in finance and accounting. The People's Committee said the market-based salary regime is intended to attract personnel with professional expertise, foreign language skills, international experience, and knowledge of international finance. The management agency is classified as a special administrative body responsible for directly running, licensing, and overseeing investment and financial business activities within the financial center while also carrying out new and complex functions in Vietnam. Its personnel are currently paid under the existing salary system, but the city government admitted that the highest salary of just VND11.6 million per month is not competitive enough to attract talent in international finance. The management agency has been using its regular operating budget to pay salaries since February 2026, but with the funding expected to last only another two months, the city government warned that without a special salary and remuneration mechanism being issued in time, 88% of employees face the risk of not being paid salaries, potentially causing resignations. For the chairperson and vice chairperson of the agency, who concurrently serve in other positions, the proposal is for an additional 50% on top of their salaries. Government workers deputed to work at the agency will also receive an additional allowance equivalent to 50% of their salary. The total annual cost of the proposed salaries, benefits, and bonuses is estimated at VND99.648 billion. It will initially be paid by the city, and once the financial center generates revenues, it will share the cost with the city.

Export value, however, fell by 11.2% due to lower prices, according to the Vietnam Coffee Cocoa Association. The EU and the US continue to be the main export markets for Vietnamese coffee. Meanwhile, several Asian markets, particularly China, are emerging as new growth drivers for the industry. Nguyen Nam Hai, the association's chairman, said Vietnamese coffee has ample opportunities to accelerate growth in both volume and prices in the final months of the year. Coffee prices are forecast to be supported by several factors. Climate change and heavy rainfall have delayed harvesting in Brazil while the El Niño weather phenomenon, heatwaves and drought are expected to affect Asia in late 2026 and 2027, potentially impacting coffee production and supply. Low inventory levels are another supporting factor. The European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) will officially take effect on Dec. 30, except for small and micro enterprises. The association said this presents an opportunity for Vietnamese coffee to boost exports, amid the relatively low level of compliance among some other producing countries. Export growth in the coming period will depend heavily on the ability to meet sustainability standards, particularly the EUDR, alongside efforts to increase deep processing and improve product quality. Many buyers are focusing on purchasing EUDR-compliant Vietnamese coffee for contracts to be signed from October. This could help increase export volume by 8-10%. In particular, EUDR-compliant shipments are expected to command prices of around $50 per tonne, higher than conventional coffee. Hai said global demand for deeply processed products is growing strongly. They are therefore also expected to become a key driver helping the industry work towards its target of $9 billion in coffee exports this year. However, he noted that the market is also facing developments that could push prices down. According to forecasts by the US Department of Agriculture, coffee production in major producing countries is generally expected to increase in the 2026-2027 crop year compared with 2025-2026. Global coffee supply is estimated at around 189 million bags, while consumption in major markets such as the U.S. and Europe is expected to stand at only around 179 million bags, leaving a surplus of 10 million bags that could drive down prices.

picked.t: Vietnamese engineer at Australia's No. 1 university develops patch that can hear hearts
picked.body: The device, called AusculPatch, measures roughly 20 by 47 by 3 millimeters. At its center is an ultra-thin silicon cantilever, separated from its frame by an air gap about a micron wide, that picks up the faint mechanical vibrations traveling through skin from the heart, lungs and blood vessels. A coin cell battery and an integrated chip convert those vibrations into a readout a doctor can review remotely. The team described the work in June in the journal Nature Communications, with UNSW doctoral candidate Tran Bach Dang as first author. The sensor reads across a band from 0.2 Hz to more than 10 kHz, capturing pulse waves, heart sounds, breathing patterns and vocal cord vibrations. "Our goal is to develop cheap but effective devices so that people can monitor their own health at home," Phuong said. Phuong holds a Scientia Associate Professorship in UNSW's School of Mechanical and Manufacturing Engineering and, since 2024, a Future Fellowship from the Australian Research Council. His group works on semiconductor devices including MEMS and NEMS, integrated sensors and flexible electronics. UNSW placed 19th in the world and first in Australia in the 2027 QS World University Rankings released in June, the first time it has topped the national table. Phuong already excelled academically in high school, where he won third prize at the national level and reached the selection round for Vietnam's International Mathematical Olympiad team. He was admitted without examination to Hanoi University of Science and Technology in 2004 to study automation. His father fell ill that same year and needed intensive care. Phuong told himself he had to become a good enough engineer to look after his family. After a strong first year he won a full Japanese government scholarship. He arrived without the language. He and other international students spent a year at Tokyo University of Foreign Studies before sitting entrance exams for their specializations. "I buried myself in preparation and worked twice as hard to compete, and I got into the mechanical engineering department at the University of Tokyo," he said. In his fourth year he spent almost all his time in the laboratory, writing a thesis on sensors for mobility assistance robots meant to help the elderly, medical staff lifting patients and workers doing heavy labor. He stayed at Tokyo for a master's, switching fully to semiconductor sensors. Two members of his group dropped out. "The pressure was enormous, but I think Vietnamese people have one strength, which is resilience and endurance," he said. He finished in 2013 and moved to Griffith University in Australia for a doctorate under two Vietnamese supervisors, Dzung Viet Dao and Nam-Trung Nguyen, building sensors for harsh industrial environments. Visiting his father in hospital, he had watched patients pinned in place by equipment trailing cables, and thought wireless and flexible would be better. Silicon carbide is rigid and brittle because it is grown on a hard silicon base. Working on a project to cool high-power electronics in 2017, Phuong found it could be lifted onto a soft one. He approached John Rogers, a leading soft electronics researcher at Northwestern University, and spent 2019 there as a visiting scholar. After repeated failures the transfer worked, and the results ran in ACS Nano in 2019 and in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences in 2022. Doctors began working with him on implants that could sit inside the body for years without replacement. Their questions sent him back to devices worn outside it, this time for people with heart disease or at risk of it. Patients with heart conditions have to travel to a clinic to be assessed, Phuong said, which delays detection and worsens outcomes. Rather than improve the stethoscope, his team built something that sticks to the chest and sends data to a doctor over the internet. The group modeled the sensor to catch the very low frequencies of heart sound, obtained approval for human trials, and tuned the adhesive so the patch would hold without irritating skin. In a separate demonstration, they trained a machine learning model on throat vibrations to recognize spoken words and wirelessly steer a robotic arm, a result they say could eventually help people with speech disorders. Phuong is now working with St Vincent's Hospital in Sydney to gather data, with roughly 200 patients targeted this year, all of them either living with heart valve disease or using left ventricular assist devices. A machine learning model trained on that data would then predict which valve condition a patient has. Studies of about 1,000 patients are planned after that, and Phuong estimates four to five years before a medical-grade version could reach clinics. He also collaborates on a soft micro-endoscopic robot led by UNSW associate professor Do Thanh Nho, designed to detect and remove cancers in tubular organs such as the breast, lungs and pancreas. picked.t: CapitaLand Development begins handover of 2,375 Lumi Hanoi homes
picked.body: The handover is part of CLD's plan to deliver nearly 3,000 homes across Vietnam this year. Standard apartments are fully finished, while duplexes are delivered in basic finished condition and penthouses as bare shells, giving buyers greater flexibility in interior design. Spanning 5.6 hectares, Lumi Hanoi comprises nine towers of 29 to 35 stories and nearly 4,000 residences, including one- to three-bedroom apartments, duplexes and penthouses. The project is developed by CLD in a joint venture with Mitsubishi Estate and Far East Organization. Tan Tze Wooi, CEO of CapitaLand Development (Vietnam), said the handovers marked an important milestone for homeowners and the developer. "We are grateful for the trust and support of our homebuyers. Seeing residents move into Lumi Hanoi brings to life a community designed around well-being, connectivity, and everyday convenience," Tan said. Together with upcoming handovers at The Fullton Edition and Orchard Hill later this year, CLD expects to deliver close to 3,000 homes in Vietnam in 2026, he added. Lumi Hanoi features more than 80 amenities, including 12 sports courts and three outdoor swimming pools. The development also features a nine-story parking facility and an automated mechanical parking system in the basement. More than 75% of the site is allocated to greenery and landscaping, including hills, ecosystem ponds, a biotope system and rainwater harvesting infrastructure. A central park features a 200-meter elevated treetop promenade connecting landscaped areas and facilities. Lumi Hanoi has received preliminary EDGE (Excellence in Design for Greater Efficiencies) certification from the International Finance Corporation. Located along Thang Long Highway with direct access to Ring Road 3.5, Lumi Hanoi is connected to Hanoi's central business district and surrounding education, healthcare, shopping, leisure and business areas. The project is also expected to benefit from future metro expansion and community facilities scheduled to open in 2027, including a five-hectare green park, kindergarten, secondary school and public bus connections. Lumi Hanoi was designed around a "city of light" concept, using architecture, landscaping and communal spaces to incorporate natural light throughout the development. Studio Milou is the lead architect, with SuMisura and 2ND Edition collaborating on interior design. Following handover, homeowners can use CapitaOne, CLD's mobile app, to access property information, payment schedules, estimated handover dates, property portfolios and contract details. The app is available on Google Play and Apple's App Store.

picked.t: ‘중국 3대 청과류 공급국’ 베트남, 대중 수출 호조…6월 기준 21.6억 달러 전년동기比 19.3%↑
picked.body: 기사 이해를 돕기위해 AI를 활용해 제작한 이미지입니다. 중국의 3대 청과류 공급국인 베트남이 상반기 시장 입지를 확대하며 2위인 칠레와의 격차를 좁힌 것으로 나타났다. 중국 해관총서(세관)에 따르면, 상반기 중국은 베트남산 채소·화훼·근채류·과일 수입에 약 21억6,000만 달러를 쓴 것으로 잠정 집계됐다. 지난해 같은 기간과 비교하면 19.3% 늘어난 것이다. 올해 상반기 중국의 청과류 수입 시장에서 베트남의 시장 점유율은 전년 대비 2.2%포인트 오른 16%로 태국(37%)과 칠레(17%)에 이어 3위를 달렸다. 칠레와의 격차가 1%포인트로 좁혀진 것이다. 베트남의 이런 약진은 수출 규모 확대와 함께 품목 구성 변화가 함께 작용한 결과로, 그중에서도 두리안이 가장 큰 성장 동력이 됐다. 상반기 중국의 대(對)베트남 두리안(생·냉동 포함) 수입액은 전년 동기 대비 43% 급증한 약 9억8,800만 달러를 기록했다. 같은 기간 코코넛 수출도 큰 폭으로 늘었지만, 망고·용과·바나나 등 열대과일 수출은 줄었다. 이에 대해 베트남청과협회는 “지리적 인접성 덕분에 베트남산 신선 농산물은 역내국 또는 남미산보다 더 빨리 중국에 도달하고, 품질을 더 잘 유지하며, 물류비도 절감할 수 있다. 이런 이점은 운송시간에 크게 좌우되는 신선 과일에 특히 중요하다”며 “중국 내 열대과일 수요가 주요 대도시를 넘어 2·3선 도시와 북부·서부 지방으로 확대되면서, 중국과 지리적으로 가까운 공급국일수록 성장 여력이 커지고 있다”고 평가했다. 업계는 올들어 중국 당국이 공식 수입을 허가한 베트남산 과일 품목이 늘어나면서 베트남 국내 농가도 재배 면적과 생산 확대에 나설 수 있는 여건이 마련됐다는 평가다. 다만 중국은 늘어난 품목 만큼이나 수입 요건도 갈수록 엄격하게 적용하고 있다. 업계에 따르면 중국은 사업자등록부터 재배지역코드, 포장시설에 이르기까지 전반적인 감독을 강화하고 있다. 협회는 “원산지 위조, 재배지역 코드 오남용, 병해충 오염 등이 발생하면 해당 코드가 일시 정지되거나 취소될 수 있으며, 이는 해당 재배지역 전체의 수출에 직접적인 영향을 미칠 수 있다”며 품질 관리에 만전을 기할 것을 농가들에 조언했다.

picked.t: 베트남, 외국인 주택 소유주 ‘임대차계약’ 체결 시 신고 의무화…과태료 최대 5,000만 동
picked.body: 베트남 호치민시의 한 아파트 단지. 베트남이 외국인 주택 소유자에 대한 법적 책임을 강화한다. 이에 따라 외국인 주택 소유자는 임대차 관련 규정 위반 시 최대 5,000만 동(1,917달러)의 과태료를 부과받을 수 있어 각별한 주의가 요구된다. 베트남 정부는 최근 이러한 내용을 담은 ‘부동산 사업 및 주택 개발, 건설 분야에 대한 행정제재 규정인 시행령 제339/2026/ND-CP호’를 공포했다. 해당 시행령은 지난달 26일부터 적용되고 있다. 본 시행령에 따르면 외국인(개인) 주택 소유자는 임대 전 관계당국에 임대 의사를 서면으로 신고하지 않거나, 임대차 계약 종료를 서면으로 신고하지 않을 경우 2,000만~3,000만 동(767~1,150달러)의 과태료가 부과된다. 또한 주택 소유 자격이 없거나 소유 요건을 충족하지 못한 상태에서 주택을 소유한 외국인에게는 3,000만~5,000만 동(1,150~1,917달러)의 과태료가 부과될 수 있으며, 베트남 내 금융기관을 거치지 않고 주택 매매·리스구매 대금을 지급한 경우, 정해진 기한을 넘겨 소유 기간 연장을 신청한 경우 역시 동일한 과태료가 부과된다. 이러한 경우, 규정 위반자는 해당 주택이 계속 임대 중이라면 임대 사실을, 임대차 계약이 종료된 경우 역시 당국에 서면으로 신고해야 한다. 소유 자격이 없이 없음에도 주택을 소유한 외국인은 해당 주택을 매도인에게 반환하고 기지급 금액을 돌려받아야 한다. 이번 시행령은 베트남 내 주택을 소유한 개인 외 외국계 법인에 대한 제재 규정도 함께 명시하고 있다. 구체적으로 주택 소유 자격이 없거나 소유 요건을 충족하지 못한 외국 법인, 혹은 소속 직원이 아닌 타인을 해당 주택에 거주하도록 한 경우, 베트남 내 은행을 통하지 않고 다른 수단으로 구매대금을 지불하는 경우 등의 행위에는 6,000만 동(2,300달러)에서 최대 1억 동(3,834달러)의 과태료가 부과된다. 이에 대해 현지 전문가는 “이번 시행령은 베트남 내 외국인 개인·법인의 주택 소유·이용에 관한 규정을 구체화하고 보다 엄격히 집행하겠다는 정부의 의지를 보여주는 것”이라고 풀이했다.

picked.t: 베트남, ‘16세 미만 아동’ 밤 9시 이후 PC방 출입제한 추진…청소년 게임 이중규제
picked.body: 기사 이해를 돕기위해 AI를 활용해 제작한 이미지입니다. 베트남이 청소년 보호를 강화하기 위해 게임장 심야 영업과 온라인게임 이용시간을 동시에 규제하는 방안을 추진하고 있다. 현재 정부가 심의 중인 시행령 개정안에는 16세 미만 청소년의 야간시간대 PC방 출입 제한과 동시에 미성년자의 하루 게임 이용시간을 제한하는 방안이 모두 포함돼 관심을 받고 있다. 해당 내용은 법무부가 심의 중인 ‘인터넷·온라인정보 서비스 관리·제공·이용에 관한 시행령’ 제147/2024/ND-CP호 일부 개정안에 포함됐다. 이번 개정안은 게임 이용 시간과 콘텐츠에 대한 통제를 통해 아동 보호를 강화하는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 주목할 만한 점은 이번 개정안에 16세 미만 청소년은 오후 9시부터 익일 오전 8시까지, 16세 이상은 자정부터 익일 오전 8시까지 공공 온라인게임 서비스 제공시설(PC방)에 출입을 금지한다는 내용이 담겼다는 점이다. 현행 규정은 이 같은 시설의 영업 제한 시간을 밤 10시부터 익일 오전 8시까지로 규정하고 있을 뿐, 연령대별 출입 제한은 규정돼 있지 않다. 이 밖에도 개정안은 온라인 플랫폼을 이용하는 아동들의 연령대가 낮아지는 반면, 각 가정에서의 효과적인 관리·감독 부재로 인해 유해 콘텐츠가 아동에게 부정적인 영향을 미치고 있다고 평가하며, 16세 미만 청소년의 하루 게임 시간을 총 60분 미만으로 제한한다는 내용이 포함됐다. 이에 따라 각 게임 업체는 16세 미만 이용자로 하여금 자사가 제공 중인 모든 게임의 합산 이용시간이 60분을 초과하지 않도록 보장하는 기술적 조치 시행이 의무화될 전망이다. 이는 18세 미만 이용자 전체에 공통으로 하루 최대 180분 한도를 두고 있는 현행 규정보다 훨씬 엄격하고 촘촘한 기준이다. 또한 휴대전화 번호로 인증되지 않은 체험용 계정은 계정 생성일로부터 최대 7일간 플레이가 허용되며, 어떤 형태로든 가상아이템·가상화폐·포인트 구매를 위한 충전이 금지된다. 허용 활동 기한이 지난 뒤에도 계정 인증 조치가 이뤄지지 않을 경우, 게임사는 업체는 해당 계정의 접근을 차단해야 한다. 이 밖에도 개정안에는 게임서비스 제공업체가 결제 관리를 위해 베트남 내 최소 1개 이상의 서버ㅅ를 두고, 감독·점검 업무를 위해 이용자 데이터를 베트남 내에 저장하도록 하는 규정이 포함됐다. 이번 개정안은 오는 11월 중 공포될 예정이다.

picked.t: UK travel platform names Sa Pa among Southeast Asia's top destinations
picked.body: Sa Pa has been included in the list alongside Bagan in Myanmar, Coron in the Philippines, Sumatra in Indonesia, and Chiang Mai in Thailand. Writer Leslie Finlay describes Sa Pa as a remote mountain town in northern Vietnam's Hoang Lien Son range, home to Indochina's highest mountain Fansipan that peaks at 3,143 meters above sea level, with landscapes more reminiscent of trekking destinations than the jungles and beaches commonly associated with Southeast Asia. The article also highlights the area's ethnic diversity and communities that have lived in the region for generations. The recognition follows several international accolades. In 2023, Condé Nast Traveler named Sa Pa among the world's 50 most beautiful small towns. In 2024, it ranked among TripAdvisor's five trending destinations worldwide, while Condé Nast Traveler again included it on its list of 53 of the world's most beautiful small towns in early 2026. Reaching Fansipan once required a trek lasting several days. Since the Sun World Fansipan Legend cable car opened in 2016, the summit has become accessible to more visitors, including children and elderly travelers. Visitors first take the Muong Hoa funicular through the valley and terraced rice fields before continuing by three-rope cable car over Hoang Lien National Park to the summit. Tourism around Fansipan has expanded beyond the summit. Ban May Village showcases the cultures of ethnic communities in northwestern Vietnam through traditional houses, handicrafts, festivals, folk performances, and local cuisine. At Cloud Yard, 3,063 meters above sea level, Starbucks Fansipan opened in March 2026, offering views of the Hoang Lien Son range and surrounding clouds. The mountain is also home to a spiritual and cultural complex featuring Kim Son Bao Thang Pagoda, a giant Amitabha Buddha statue, and a path lined with Arhat statues. Sa Pa has also added new accommodation options, including Hotel de la Coupole – MGallery Sa Pa, designed by architect Bill Bensley. The hotel combines French haute couture influences with colors and patterns associated with ethnic communities in northwestern Vietnam.

picked.t: 베트남 증시, 장중 12포인트 급락 후 반등...빈그룹이 상승 주도
picked.body: 베트남 호찌민시 증권거래소에서 투자자들이 전광판에 표시된 주가 움직임을 살펴보고 있다. /사진= Vietstock (호치민=베트남코리아타임즈) 홍 리 (Hong Ly) 기자 = 베트남 증시가 8일 장중 12포인트 넘게 급락했다가 반등하며 상승 마감했다. 대형주를 중심으로 매수세가 유입된 가운데 빈그룹(VIC)이 지수 상승을 이끌었다. 호찌민증권거래소의 VN지수는 이날 전 거래일보다 8.80포인트(0.48%) 오른 1,830.44포인트로 거래를 마쳤다. 하노이증권거래소의 HNX지수는 0.51포인트 상승한 281.11포인트, 비상장주식시장인 UPCoM지수는 0.14포인트 오른 127.78포인트를 기록했다. 이날 증시는 큰 변동성을 보였다. VN지수는 개장 초 6포인트 이상 상승했지만 곧바로 하락세로 돌아섰고, 장중 한때 12포인트 넘게 밀리며 1,815포인트선까지 떨어졌다. 오후 들어 대형주를 중심으로 매수세가 유입되면서 분위기가 반전됐다. VN지수는 오후 들어 낙폭을 빠르게 만회한 뒤 상승세로 돌아섰고, 결국 전 거래일보다 0.48% 오른 채 장을 마쳤다. 다만 거래대금은 14조1,849억동(약 7,960억원)으로 집계돼 상승세가 강하게 확산되지는 않았다. 특히 빈그룹 주가는 이날 1.88% 상승했다. VN지수 상승폭 8.80포인트 가운데 7.55포인트가 빈그룹의 상승에서 비롯됐다. 다른 종목들의 지수 기여도가 대부분 1포인트를 밑돈 것과 비교하면 빈그룹의 영향력이 두드러졌다. 반면 빈홈즈(VHM)는 1.21% 하락하며 VN지수에서 1.5포인트 이상을 끌어내렸다. 빈파이(VPI)는 3.14%, 빈컴리테일(VRE)은 2.96% 하락하는 등 부동산주 내에서도 종목별 차별화가 나타났다. 금융주 역시 등락이 엇갈렸다. 세아은행(SSB)은 0.84%, 사이공증권(SSI)은 0.72%, 베트남투자개발은행(BID)은 0.56%, 비엣캐피털증권(VIX)은 1.10% 상승했다. 반면 록팟은행(LPB)은 1.31%, 사콤은행(STB)은 0.65%, 사이공-하노이은행(SHB)은 0.42%, 군대은행(MBB)은 0.25% 하락했다. 업종별로는 에너지 업종이 2.18% 상승하며 가장 강한 흐름을 보였다. 페트로베트남운송(PVT)은 6.77%, 페트로베트남기술서비스(PVS)는 4.29%, 빈선정유화학(BSR)은 2.66%, 페트로리멕스(PLX)는 1.71% 상승했다. 기초소재 업종도 0.52% 올랐으며 호아팟그룹(HPG)은 1.39% 상승했다. 반면 기술 업종은 0.33% 하락했고, 대표적인 기술주 FPT는 0.28% 떨어졌다. 이날 전체 거래량은 약 5억5,948만주였으며, 금융업종의 거래대금은 약 4조856억동(약 2,295억원)으로 가장 많았다. 부동산 업종은 약 3조2,468억동(약 1,822억원)으로 뒤를 이었다. 외국인 투자자는 이날도 순매도를 이어갔다. 외국인은 전체 시장에서 약 3,850억동(약 216억원)어치의 주식을 순매도했다. 호찌민증권거래소에서는 약 3,990억동(약 224억원)을 순매도한 것으로 집계됐다. 종목별로는 비엣콤은행(VCB)이 외국인 순매도 규모가 약 860억동(약 48억원)으로 가장 컸고, VP은행(VPB)과 닷산그룹(DXG)도 각각 약 770억동(약 43억원), 550억동(약 31억원) 이상 순매도됐다. 반면 FPT는 외국인 순매수 규모가 약 650억동(약 36억원)으로 가장 컸으며, VIB도 420억동(약 24억원) 이상 순매수됐다. 증권업계에서는 이날 반등에도 단기적인 변동성이 이어질 가능성을 경계하고 있다. 사이공-하노이증권(SHS)은 VN지수가 단기적으로 1,800포인트 부근까지 조정을 받을 가능성을 제시했다. 비엣콤증권(VCBS)도 매도세가 우위를 보이고 있고 매수세가 약해지고 있어 VN지수가 당분간 등락을 이어갈 수 있다고 분석했다. 이날 VN지수는 장중 큰 폭으로 밀렸다가 반등했지만 외국인의 순매도가 이어지고 대형주 사이에서도 등락이 엇갈렸다. 빈그룹의 상승이 지수를 지탱한 가운데 향후 1,800포인트선을 지지할 수 있을지가 단기적인 시장 흐름을 가를 전망이다.   <저작권자(c) 베트남코리아타임즈, 무단 전재-재배포 금지>
